description: We’re HexaNova, a team of six enthusiastic CSE students of BRAC University, passionate about technology, creativity, problem-solving, and space exploration. This is our first NASA Space Apps Challenge, and we’re excited to learn, build, and give our best. We’re looking to share ideas, learn together, and build something meaningful In Sha Allah
summary:
**Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer**, developed by Team HexaNova from Dhaka, Bangladesh, is an interactive educational game designed to spark curiosity about space exploration among young minds. Inspired by NASA's challenge to build an Astronaut Mission Trainer, we developed a simple, engaging game that introduces children to the experiences and challenges astronauts face during space missions.

Through interactive activities, players explore concepts such as astronaut training, spacecraft systems, growing plants in space, food and nutrition, and lunar survival. The project draws inspiration from NASA resources and real-world space exploration concepts, transforming them into accessible, play-based learning experiences.

Our goal is to make space education more engaging and approachable for children, encouraging them to explore beyond everyday digital entertainment. By turning screen time into an opportunity for discovery, we hope to nurture curiosity, inspire scientific thinking, and motivate the next generation to look beyond Earth and imagine what is possible.
